slides.headline: 5 mistakes that cost sellers offers
slides.body: Most are fixed in a weekend. Save this before your first viewing.

slides.headline: Ignoring the small repairs
slides.body: Dripping taps, loose handles, blown globes. Buyers add up every one.

slides.headline: Too much stuff on show
slides.body: Clear counters, tables and shelves. Rooms look bigger straight away.

slides.headline: Dark rooms on viewing day
slides.body: Clean the windows and open every curtain before buyers arrive.

slides.headline: A messy way in
slides.body: Buyers judge from the gate. Sweep the path, trim the garden, clean the front door.

slides.headline: Leaving paperwork too late
slides.body: Plans, guarantees and certificates. Ask early what you will need.

slides.headline: Get your home ready to sell
slides.body: A free market analysis of your home, plus my get-your-home-ready checklist.
